why: JSON reads only the 0 of 01 as a number, a zero is not followed by digits; what follows is text after the number, as 10.0bar is the number 10.0 then bar (unquoted-strings.9), and a number keeps the text it was written with in a concatenation, so the value is the string "01". typesafe/config reads the number 1. Settled number-like reading in Readings: JSON's number or text as written, not L272-as-error and not typesafe/config's lenient parser.
